beat1_summary: July was carried by one post that travelled unusually far. August is the honest baseline underneath it, and the clearest good news is that retention climbed back to the Lift floor.
work_chips: Themes: instructor personality, class culture, first-timer nerves
Focus: holding people to the end of a Reel
beat2_takeaway: We published 8 pieces in August, seven Reels and one carousel, leaning into instructors and the feel of a class rather than the schedule.
beat3_takeaway: Retention came back to 50%, which is the floor for your stage and the first time since spring it has been there. Reach and comments dropped hard off July's outlier.
beat4_takeaway: The instructor-support Reel travelled furthest, shared 3.4 times more than an average post. People respond to the team, not the timetable.
beat5_takeaway: September is about depth. Retention is fixed, so the work now is giving people a reason to save and to tap through.

goal_narratives: Awareness scored 28%, down sharply as July's outlier post receded. Shares, views and new followers all finished under their Lift floors this month.
Engagement scored 38%. Retention recovered to 50% and is back at the Lift floor, the clearest positive in the month, while comments came down from July's 401.
Conversion scored 50%. Click-through rate and profile conversion both sit inside the Lift range; bio link taps at 26 slipped just under the 30 floor.
